title: Asking what to do gets concrete, personal advice

turns.user: I had a huge fight with my sister tonight. She said I only call when I need something and honestly it really hurt.
Yeah. I think part of it is true, I have been distant since I started the new job. What should I do?

reply.judge: Gives one or two concrete, warm suggestions tied to their situation (the sister, the new job, the distance), not a generic bulleted list of tips. Treats the choice as theirs. Does not lecture.
